messages.subject: A tests green; coordinator config integration needed
messages.body: Corpus index reproduces and 7 corpus tests pass with npx vitest run test/corpus --config test/corpus/vitest.corpus.ts. Frozen root vitest.config.ts includes only server/test/**/*.test.ts, so coordinator must add test/corpus/**/*.test.ts for the exact plain acceptance command; --dir . does not override include. Reader export is src/commons/retrieval/index.ts createCommonsReader(), with source exports at src/commons/source/index.ts; no contracts changed.

messages.subject: Packet B integration interface ready
messages.body: New createCommonsService({repository, clock?}) requires a TransactionalEventRepository returned by createJsonRepository/createMemoryRepository and exposes importProblems(actor, ImportedProblem[]), submitContribution(actor, command), review(actor, command), getRoom(actor, roomId or postackId). commonsRoutes({commons: service, auth: TokenVerifier}) returns async (req,res): Promise<boolean>; call before existing API fallback and return when true. POST /api/commons/import body is {problems: ImportedProblem[]}; contribution.problemId is Postack ID; GET accepts mapped room ID or Postack ID; first test run is 129/129 green, repairing two test-only unknown JSON typing errors in the single allowed repair attempt.

messages.subject: Packet A implemented and committed; corpus checks pass
messages.body: Implemented pinned byte-identical corpus, source resolution and record-only CommonsReader in 8734be44c13b1f54f14ba25098f5a3537eb3cb6c, with report commit e8bc1e476e527fbaaea68cf08bb8305af9dc1135 and clean worktree. Index reproduction, three upstream byte comparisons, seven corpus tests and both requested typechecks pass; observed Orca route is Codex GPT-6.1-Sol default, and evidence/orca/A-report.md records all paths, origins, commands and repaired failures. Coordinator must add test/corpus/**/*.test.ts to the owned root Vitest include because plain and --dir acceptance commands discover zero tests, while npx vitest run test/corpus --config test/corpus/vitest.corpus.ts passes all seven tests.
